spans.s:
पुक्कश पुक्कश or पुक्कस, अस्, m. epithet
of a degraded mixed caste (erroneously identified by
lexicographers with the Cāṇḍālas), the offspring of a
Ni-ṣāda by a Śūdrā female, a man of an impure or
degraded tribe or occupation; (ई), f. a woman of the
Pukkaśa caste; a bud, blossom; the indigo plant;
(अस्, ई, अम्), low, vile.

पुक्कशक, अस्, m. a man of the Pukkaśa caste;
(अस्, आ, अम्), low, vile.
